description: This is a localization source file containing Czech translations and dynamic message formatting functions for a chat application, including UI labels, prompts, error messages, and settings descriptions.

methods.name: ChatItem.ChatItemCount
methods.description: Returns a localized string with the count of messages.

methods.name: Chat.SubTitle
methods.description: Returns a localized string indicating number of messages with ChatGPT.

methods.name: Chat.Actions
methods.description: Provides localized labels for chat-related actions.

methods.name: Chat.Input
methods.description: Generates input hint string based on submit key, including shift+enter info and search prompt.

methods.name: Export.Title
methods.description: Localized title for the export section.

methods.name: Memory.Title
methods.description: Localized title for the memory section.

methods.name: Memory.ResetConfirm
methods.description: Confirmation message for resetting memory and conversation history.

methods.name: Settings.Lang.All
methods.description: Localized string for all available languages.

methods.name: Settings.Update.FoundUpdate
methods.description: Informs about a new available update.

methods.name: Store.Prompt.History
methods.description: Creates a prompt summarizing chat history.

methods.name: Store.Prompt.Topic
methods.description: Creates a prompt requesting a four- to five-word title.

methods.name: Store.Prompt.Summarize
methods.description: Creates a prompt for summarizing a conversation.

methods.name: Context.Toast
methods.description: Displays usage of context instructions count.

methods.name: Mask.EditModal.Title
methods.description: Generates title string for editing a prompt template, indicating read-only status.

methods.name: NewChat.Title
methods.description: Title for selecting a mask for new chat.
